email.body1:
Duane, saw HSI unveiled Sky, your AI assistant, and partnered with Enhesa to expand compliance software.

New product surface usually means more target accounts than reps can work, and the bottleneck becomes the lag between a signal firing and someone acting on it. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, written, followed-up outreach autonomously, so signal-to-action latency drops and coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Duane, quick follow-up for HSI.

Expanding the software catalog multiplies target accounts faster than ops can keep data clean or reps can follow up. The win is measurable lift per rep, not more seats and more manual work.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Duane, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to other compliance-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to HSI either way.
